minutes_text:
MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES
  MONDAY, NOVEMBER 28, 2022 AT 8:00 A.M.
  BARTH ROOM, CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY

CALL TO ORDER: Chairperson Domier called the regular meeting to order at 8:03 a.m. in the
Barth Room, located at 1890 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Chairperson Domier led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  PRESENT: Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Derry, Trustee
  Osegueda, and Chairperson Domier

  ABSENT: Trustee Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

BOARD OF TRUSTEES REPORTS

1. CHAIRPERSON REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared his gratitude for the Board of Trustees and that he looks forward to
an equally productive year for the group in 2023.

2. TRUSTEE REPORTS

Alternate Wahl, Alternate Wu, Trustee Derry, and Trustee Osegueda, did not have anything to
report.

3. CRAIN ART GALLERY LIAISON REPORT

No report was given. Chairperson Domier noted that artwork of former Trustee, Linda Mollno, is
currently on display in the Crain Art Gallery.

4. SAN MARINO CENTER RENOVATION UPDATE REPORT

Chairperson Domier shared that a few City Council Members were given a tour recently, and the
Task Force will be given a tour in the coming weeks, as demolition is almost complete. Director
Johnson added that she requested monthly updates on the project from the project manager for
Chairperson Domier to share at each meeting and for the City’s website for all to see.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
NOVEMBER 28, 2022  PAGE 2 OF 3

5. FRIENDS OF THE CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY LIAISON REPORT
Trustee Derry shared that the Friends are discussing buying new book bags, which will be given out
to customers who spend $10 or more. She added that the Book Shoppe is now open 7 days a week
and doing very well.

6. SAN MARINO PUBLIC LIBRARY FOUNDATION LIAISON REPORT
No report was given.

NEW BUSINESS

7. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Trustee Derry, to approve the minutes from October 24,
2022.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Chairperson Domier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun

8. DIRECTOR AND LIBRARY MANAGER REPORT

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.

Chairperson Domier inquired about the CENIC rebate line item on the Budget Monitor. Library
Manager Vera responded that high speed internet for the Library is provided at a discounted rate,
and the Library receives an annual rebate to account for the discount. Chairperson Domier inquired
about the timing of the donation from the Foundation’s Literary Libations event. Director Johnson
responded that she is unsure of the exact timing, but it will happen this fiscal year. Trustee Osegueda
inquired about the timing of the Computer Room renovation. Director Johnson responded that the
renovation will occur this fiscal year.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  - None

9. FY 2021-22 CALIFORNIA STATE LIBRARY REPORT

Library Manager Vera presented the staff report.
 LIBRARY BOARD OF TRUSTEES MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
NOVEMBER 28, 2022  PAGE 3 OF 3

Trustee Derry inquired about the Reference Desk. Library Manager Vera explained that reference
services are now being offered at the front counter to offer more flexible and robust service. Trustee
Derry asked what the plans are for the old Reference Desk. Library Manager Vera responded that
staff are observing patron needs to determine the use of that space.

The following person(s) provided comment:
  None

Trustee Osegueda moved, seconded by Trustee Derry, to receive and file the fiscal year 2021-22
California State Library Report and recommend it for ratification by the City Council.

Motion passed by the following vote:

AYES:  Trustee Derry, Trustee Osegueda, Chairperson Dornier
NOES:  None
ABSTAIN:  None
ABSENT:  Trustee Chien, Vice Chairperson Sadun

PRESENTATION

10.2023 OPEN HOUSE PLANNING

Director Johnson and Library Manager Vera provided a verbal report on the planning efforts for the
2023 Open House event.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

The following person(s) provided written communications or public writings:
  None

ADIOURNMENT

Chairperson Dornier adjourned the meeting at 8:44 a.m.
